title: Museum of Western Film History

services.name: Exhibits
services.desc: The variety of the Museum exhibits will interest young and old alike. Western lovers will appreciate all the information about movies shot here. Cinephiles will enjoy the documentation of many actors and directors and the various movie cameras and early film projector we have in the Museum’s collection. Those interested in the stuntmen will read all about their favorites and learn more about their contributions to movie making. Everyone will enjoy reading about the area and how the Alabama Hills became one of Hollywood’s biggest Western Backlots. services.name: Self-Guided Tours
services.desc: Begin by browsing through our popular self-guided tours. You can also search for a tour of your favorite film. Our research department is actively working on more tours. Better yet, at the Lone Pine Film Festival you can join a tour led by our expert Western film docents. Have car, will travel. Even though there's no internet in the Alabama Hills, we have self-guided pdf tour brochures: when viewing any of the tours below, just click the Create PDF button.
